prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: pixel-art NPC horizontal thinking-gaze atlas
Primary request: Create one 2x2 atlas from this sad portrait reference. Order: LEFT OPEN, RIGHT OPEN / LEFT HALF-CLOSED, RIGHT HALF-CLOSED.
Input image: Use the single provided exact local reference grid as the only reference for this character, sad brows, narrow lids/apertures, compact blue-gray iris pixels, skin/hair/ornament, palette and framing. The reference grid itself is open-left, open-right / half-left, half-right, with repeated source phases.
Style/medium: Crisp restrained 1990s pixel-art upper portrait; clean hard pixel clusters, no smoothing or antialiasing.
Composition/framing: Exact 2x2 atlas with equal cells in the same 64:35 landscape aspect and framing as the reference. Keep the face, brow, hairline, blue ornament and eye spacing registered identically in every cell. No gaps, borders, labels or text.
Constraints: Only the irises/pupils shift horizontally, gently by about one native pixel. Both eyes must track together toward the viewer's left in the first column and toward the viewer's right in the second. Preserve the selected sad brow master, exact narrow open and half-closed lid contours and aperture, compact source-size blue-gray irises, dark pupils and subdued small highlights. Half-lidded row must stay half-lidded. Keep iris geometry inside the existing aperture; do not widen or raise the eyes, add broad sclera bands, enlarge/round the iris, move brows, brighten the highlights, or change any other face pixels. Preserve hair, skin, ornament, background, original pixel style and palette. No other expression, details, labels or watermark.
